title: AstraRun Real Launcher Ingress Closure Gate Matrix

criteria.criterion: Every human Launcher request reaches RequestBoundaryRouter
criteria.details: All user text submissions and suggestion selections in Launcher wrap in RequestEnvelope.create(origin=RequestOrigin.LAUNCHER) and call app.handle_request -> RequestBoundaryRouter.classify_ingress.

criteria.criterion: No conversational user-text bypass remains before the boundary
criteria.details: Removed classify_launcher_input(query) == InputIntent.NATURAL_LANGUAGE branch. Natural language queries route through RequestBoundaryRouter.

criteria.criterion: Suggestion submission cannot bypass the boundary
criteria.details: Suggestion items wrap in RequestEnvelope.create(raw_query=action, origin=RequestOrigin.LAUNCHER) and pass through app.handle_request.
RequestOrigin.LAUNCHER, RequestOrigin.CLI, and RequestOrigin.TASK_RUNTIME are correctly tagged and preserved on RequestEnvelope.

criteria.criterion: Request ID is correlated through ingress and downstream telemetry
criteria.details: 12-char hex request_id created with envelope is correlated across REQUEST_INGRESS_CLASSIFIED, REQUEST_DOWNSTREAM_SELECTED, and ExecutionResult.request_id.
Greetings ('hello', 'hi there') classify as META_COMMAND (META_GREETING), handled inline without launcher dismiss or workstation mutation.
'hello, open calculator' fails closed to OPERATIONAL_GOAL with COMPOSITE_CONTAINS_OPERATIONAL_CLAUSE and executes downstream.

criteria.criterion: Existing downstream execution behavior remains unchanged
criteria.details: All downstream routing paths (PURE_QUERY, AGENT_EXECUTION_ENGINE, DETERMINISTIC_ROUTER, LEGACY_LAYA_WORKFLOW) execute with exact semantic parity.

criteria.criterion: Actual interactive Launcher physical test passes
criteria.details: Real interactive launcher smoke test passed all 6 test cases (A-F) on active Windows desktop. Zero leaked desktop processes.

criteria.criterion: Screenshots visibly support claimed UI state
criteria.details: 13 PNG screenshots captured and verified at pixel level for foreground HWND, title, PID, and visual target content.
Calculator window verified physically visible (HWND 132488, HWND 132512), confirmed foreground and pixel color non-blank.
Full test suite executed: 1,047 passed, 14 skipped, 0 failed, 0 errors in 670.67s across 1,061 collected tests.

criteria.criterion: Historical AU-1.1A evidence is not rewritten
criteria.details: docs/audit/AU_1_1A/ remains completely untouched. All closure evidence recorded under docs/audit/AU_1_1A_C/.
No dead code deleted (reserved for AU-1.1B). No downstream router redesign or confirmation engine modification (reserved for AU-1.2).
